title: ArmorSteal Malware Steals Passwords and Crypto Wallet Data, Hides Mining When Task Manager Opens
content_md: ArmorSteal, a Python-based Windows malware kit. It steals credentials and crypto wallets, hijacks clipboard addresses, and runs a hidden Monero-style miner. The miner shuts down whenever a user opens Task Manager or another monitoring tool. Zscaler ThreatLabz documented the family on 22 October 2026.
